method: Built-in image_gen; new catalog concept, not registered as a product
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: square catalog concept image for a home gym equipment catalog, matching an established premium graphite-and-orange studio product photography collection.
Primary request: Generate a photorealistic catalog product image of ONE integrated Olympic flat bench press station WITH a racked Olympic barbell and weight plates loaded symmetrically on both ends.
Subject and geometry: a robust fixed flat bench permanently connected to two rear barbell-support uprights by a coherent steel base. One continuous horizontal black upholstered bench pad, long and narrow with softly rounded corners, at normal bench height. The head end lies between the two uprights; the foot end projects forward toward the viewer. Uprights approximately chest height for a standing person, with tidy round height-adjustment holes, a pair of physically plausible J-cups securely supporting one straight chrome Olympic barbell horizontally across the bench, perpendicular to the bench length. Each outer bar sleeve has the same stack of two large matte black round weight plates, silver hubs and a secure collar. Plates must be outboard of the uprights, both ends visible. Bar shaft is continuous and straight through aligned plate center holes. Integrated base with bolted gussets, strong rectangular steel tubing, sensible braces and black rubber feet. This is a dedicated Olympic bench, with only two short bench-press uprights, no overhead crossbar, no full power cage. Bench and uprights form one manufactured unit.
Style and palette: premium realistic studio product photography, graphite matte powder-coated steel, finely textured charcoal-black upholstery with subtle edge stitching, brushed silver bolts and chrome barbell, restrained small warm-orange bracket/gusset accents echoing the catalog's existing benches. Weight plates are black, not colorful.
Scene/backdrop: empty seamless warm off-white studio cyclorama, floor and background same softly warm ivory tone, soft diffused light, gentle realistic contact shadow beneath the entire unit. No gym interior.
Composition/framing: square high-resolution image, elevated three-quarter front view, front foot end of bench toward lower-right and head end receding toward upper-left. Clearly show the bench pad, both uprights, barbell and loaded plates at both ends. Entire product centered with generous balanced margins on all sides, neither bar end nor feet cropped. Crisp detailed manufactured hardware, realistic perspective and coherent proportions, catalog-ready polish matching minimalist e-commerce equipment photos.
Avoid: people, branding, logos, text, labels, plate lettering, dimensions, watermarks, graphic overlays, extra equipment, detached dumbbells, loose plates on floor, incline bench, leg rollers, pull-up bars, tall power rack, exaggerated orange surfaces, floating components, intersecting metal, bent bar, asymmetric plate loading.
Output one square photographic image.
review: Concept visually reviewed: integrated flat Olympic bench with two uprights, racked barbell and two black plates per side, graphite frame with small orange accents on warm off-white studio background. AI-generated visual concept, not a verified engineering design or real product photograph. No product records, models or application behavior changed.
